reason: My customers buy from me because they know me. A cold email from some domain I've never heard of isn't going to win me a distributor deal. I might take the free list of 15 companies to see what comes back, but I'm not putting EUR 500 down and then EUR 450 a meeting on strangers who don't know my business.
objection: EUR 450 for one meeting is a lot when most of those calls will just be people being polite. For up to EUR 4,100 I could buy Apollo, hire a junior SDR and keep the contacts myself, and I still believe a handshake at a fair beats any system.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 companies on the free list were ones I'd actually want and hadn't already met at fairs, and if a wholesaler like me in my product category told me personally that these meetings turned into orders.
